description: In mailbox/set.rs is_newsgroup_name, a newsgroup name is accepted if it is non-empty, contains a dot, and has no whitespace. This is weaker than the validation used elsewhere (stoa_core::article::GroupName::new). For example 'a.1b' or '.a.b' or 'a.b.' would pass is_newsgroup_name but may be rejected by GroupName::new. This means a Mailbox/set create with a name like '.foo.bar' succeeds (subscriber is written to the DB) but subsequent operations using GroupName::new would fail to recognise the group. The check should delegate to GroupName::new.
title: is_newsgroup_name validation accepts invalid group names that GroupName::new rejects
